title: Q-SPEC-11-deployed-adapter: Adapter that reads live deployments and bindings for the fleet registry and the wiring graph
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q "export function deployedPort" -- workers/adapters/cloudflare
**Status:** open

US-SPEC-11 (US-11-R02) and US-SPEC-12 (US-12-R09, US-12-R10) are built against ports: `deployed.list()` in workers/core/fleet/index.js and `metadata` in workers/core/graph/wiring.js. No adapter reads a real account, so the composition root skips the graph step (`no metadata port`) and reconciles nothing. Build workers/adapters/cloudflare/deployed.js: `deployedPort({ fetch, accountId, token })` returning `list()` (name, version, source hash, health) and a `metadata` reader (crons, routes, bindings by type, secret names only), with a worker whose call errored listed under errors and left out of counts. Test with a fake fetch in workers/adapters/cloudflare/test/, then pass both ports from workers/core/org. Paths: workers/core/fleet/index.js, workers/core/graph/wiring.js, workers/core/org/buildout.js, specs/US-SPEC-11-fleet-runtime.md, specs/US-SPEC-12-signal-organism-and-wiring.md.

size: M
**Out of scope:** hot standby of the dispatcher, a second deployed scheduler, any write to the account.

Prediction: spec_quality >= 0.9 within 336 h

**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q "deployedPort" -- workers/core/org and the status rows of US-SPEC-11 and US-SPEC-12 that name this item read BUILT with the adapter file and its test.
